571	def preflight(p):
572	    """Section 8 step 2 (ST11; B17 plus the checkpoint overhead, see the module docstring): the first configuration
573	    for the protocol's preflight steps (formal: preflight mode on the A100; smoke: smoke mode on the CPU, its numbers
574	    are smoke values). Its outputs are timing only."""
575	    pmode = M.preflight_mode(p.contract) if p.mode.formal else p.mode
576	    spec = T.search_runs(p.contract, "F")[0]
577	    p.before_run()
578	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
579	    model = p.base_model()
580	    load_s = time.perf_counter() - t0
581	    try:
582	        res = T.train_run(model, p.tok, p.rows, spec, p.contract, pmode, p.device)
583	        summ = CP.preflight_summary(res.log, p.device)
584	        t0 = time.perf_counter()
585	        E.evaluate_model(model, p.tok, p.rows, p.fz.templates, p.contract.evaluation, pmode, p.device, split="dev")
586	        eval_s = time.perf_counter() - t0
587	    except T.NonFinite as e:            # no estimate, so no ST11 judgement: stopped as for a control (ST6)
588	        STP.st6(p.fz, e.values or [float("nan")], "preflight %s: %s" % (spec.name, e), True)
589	        raise
590	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
591	    T.state_sha256(model)
592	    hash_s = time.perf_counter() - t0
593	    d = p.work / PREFLIGHT_DIR
594	    p.label_dir(d)
595	    path = d / "preflight_checkpoint.pt"
596	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
597	    torch.save({"label": pmode.label, "state_dict": model.state_dict()}, path)
598	    save_s = time.perf_counter() - t0
599	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
600	    FZ.file_sha256(path)
601	    file_hash_s = time.perf_counter() - t0
602	    del model
603	    gc.collect()
604	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
605	    fresh = p.base_model()
606	    fresh.load_state_dict(torch.load(path, map_location=p.device, weights_only=True)["state_dict"], strict=True)
607	    reload_s = time.perf_counter() - t0
608	    del fresh
609	    gc.collect()
610	    anchors = [r["ids"] for r in p.rows[T.ANCHOR_FILE]]
611	    steps = list(T.step_numbers(p.contract.training.total_steps))
612	    anchor_per_step = sum(sum(len(anchors[i]) for i in T.anchor_docs(s, p.contract.arms)) for s in steps) / len(steps)
613	    fact_per_step = sum(e["fact_tokens"] for e in res.log) / len(res.log)
614	    used = p.clock.used() if p.clock is not None else 0.0
615	    hours, parts = CP.estimate_total_hours(p.contract, summ["mean_seconds_per_step_excluding_first"], fact_per_step,
616	                                           anchor_per_step, eval_s, used)
617	    overhead, counts = checkpoint_overhead_seconds(p.contract, load_s, hash_s, save_s, reload_s, file_hash_s)
618	    p.pre = {"mean_step_s": summ["mean_seconds_per_step_excluding_first"], "a_factor": parts["a_factor"],
619	             "dev_evaluation_seconds": eval_s, "load_s": load_s, "hash_s": hash_s, "save_s": save_s,
620	             "reload_s": reload_s, "file_hash_s": file_hash_s}
621	    out = {"label": pmode.label, "mode": pmode.name, "run": spec.name, "steps": res.steps_run, "summary": summ,
622	           "dev_evaluation_seconds": eval_s, "fact_tokens_per_step": fact_per_step,
623	           "anchor_tokens_per_step": anchor_per_step, "b17_estimate_hours": hours, "b17_parts": parts,
624	           "st11_reads": "b17_estimate_hours", "st11_bound_hours": p.contract.stops.st11_hours,
625	           "checkpoint_overhead_report_only": {"seconds": overhead, "counts": counts},
626	           "b17_plus_checkpoint_overhead_hours_report_only": hours + overhead / 3600.0,
627	           "timing": p.pre, "checkpoint_file": str(path), "_files": [path]}
628	    p.log("preflight (%s): %.4f s/step, DEV evaluation %.1f s, B17 estimate %.3f h (ST11); checkpoint overhead %.3f h "
629	          "(report only; sum %.3f h)" % (pmode.name, p.pre["mean_step_s"], eval_s, hours, overhead / 3600.0,
630	                                        hours + overhead / 3600.0))
631	    return out

672	def train_and_evaluate(p, spec, n_general, selected_or_control):
673	    """One training run (protocol sections 4, 7) and the DEV evaluation of its saved final checkpoint. A non-finite
674	    value (ST6): outside the selected configurations and the controls the configuration is excluded from selection
675	    (returns a result with finite False); otherwise IMPLEMENTATION_FAIL (the stop propagates)."""
676	    p.before_run(p.run_seconds())
677	    model = p.base_model()                              # train.train_run sets up the arm (LoRA for L)
678	    rec = {"kind": "training_run", "run": spec.name, "arm": spec.arm, "config_id": spec.config_id,
679	           "config": spec.cfg, "seed": spec.seed, "phase": spec.phase, "device_name": p.device_name}
680	    ck = None
681	    try:
682	        res = T.train_run(model, p.tok, p.rows, spec, p.contract, p.mode, p.device)
683	        params_forward = sum(q.numel() for q in model.parameters())
684	        reloaded, ck = p.save_checkpoint(spec, model)
685	        del model
686	        model = None
687	        p.before_run(p.eval_seconds())
688	        ev = p.evaluate(reloaded, with_em=True, with_s_mapping=spec.arm == "S")
689	    except T.NonFinite as e:
690	        try:
691	            STP.st6(p.fz, e.values or [float("nan")], "%s: %s" % (spec.name, e), selected_or_control)
692	        except STP.Stop as stop:
693	            if not stop.exclude_config:
694	                raise
695	            if ck is None:                  # stopped in training: the state at the stop is the run's final state
696	                _, ck = p.save_checkpoint(spec, model)
697	            p.excluded.append({"run": spec.name, "reason": str(stop)})
698	            p.log("ST6: %s excluded from selection: %s" % (spec.name, stop))
699	            rec.update(finite=False, excluded=str(stop), checkpoint=ck)
700	            return {"spec": spec, "finite": False, "state_sha256": ck["state_sha256"],
701	                    "record": p.write("%s/%s.json" % (RUNS_DIR, spec.name), rec)}
702	        raise ImplementationFail("non-finite values %r without a stop" % (e.values,))
703	    summ = p.summary(ev)
704	    dnll, ppl = S.dnll(ev["general_dev"], n_general)
705	    rec.update(finite=True, steps_run=res.steps_run, contract_steps=p.contract.training.total_steps,
706	               mode_steps=p.mode.steps(p.contract.training.total_steps), trainable=res.trainable,
707	               frozen_sha256_before=res.frozen_sha256_before, frozen_sha256_after=res.frozen_sha256_after,
708	               base_trainable=res.base_trainable, notes=res.notes, log=res.log,
709	               accounting=CP.run_flops(p.contract, res, params_forward), checkpoint=ck,
710	               dev=_summary_record(summ), dnll=dnll, ppl_degradation_pct=ppl)
711	    run_path = p.write("%s/%s.json" % (RUNS_DIR, spec.name), rec)
712	    det = p.write(DETAILS_DIR + "/%s_dev.json" % spec.name, {"kind": "evaluation_details", "model": spec.name, "split": "dev",
713	                                                       "evaluation": ev})
714	    del reloaded
715	    gc.collect()
716	    if torch.device(p.device).type == "cuda":
717	        torch.cuda.empty_cache()
718	    p.log("%s: %d steps, acc_dev_learned %.4f acc_cb %.4f dNLL %.5f, state sha256 %s (unchanged after reload)" % (
719	        spec.name, res.steps_run, float(summ["acc_dev_learned"]), float(summ["acc_cb"]), dnll, ck["state_sha256"][:16]))
720	    return {"spec": spec, "finite": True, "ev": ev, "summary": summ, "dnll": dnll, "state_sha256": ck["state_sha256"],
721	            "record": run_path, "details": det}

724	def search(p, arm, n_general):
725	    """Section 7: the arm's 6 configurations with the search seed, then the selection on DEV."""
726	    results = {}
727	    for spec in T.search_runs(p.contract, arm):
728	        results[spec.name] = train_and_evaluate(p, spec, n_general, selected_or_control=False)
729	    rows = []

730	    for r in results.values():
731	        s = r["spec"]
732	        rows.append({"config_id": s.config_id, "learning_rate": s.cfg["learning_rate"], "finite": r["finite"],
733	                     "acc": r["summary"]["acc_dev_learned"] if r["finite"] else float("nan"),

783	def step7(p, runs, n, leakage, selected):
784	    """Section 8 step 7: G0.8 re-evaluation of F's selected configuration (each of the 3 checkpoints reloaded and
785	    evaluated a second time), Gate 0 G0.1-G0.10, the section 6 comparisons (reported). Formal: the Gate 0 record is
786	    committed; ST4 / ST5 when G0.7 / G0.6 do not hold."""
787	    p.step_start(7)
788	    seeds = p.contract.training.training_seeds
789	    repro, files = {}, []
790	    for seed in seeds:
791	        spec = runs[_name("F", selected["F"], seed)]["spec"]
792	        p.before_run(p.eval_seconds())
793	        model = p.load_checkpoint(spec, p.ckpt_dir / ("%s.pt" % spec.name))
794	        ev2 = control_evaluation(p, model, "G0.8 second evaluation of %s" % spec.name, with_em=False)
795	        del model
796	        gc.collect()
797	        repro[seed] = (runs[spec.name]["ev"], ev2)
798	        files.append(p.write(DETAILS_DIR + "/%s_dev_g08.json" % spec.name, {"kind": "evaluation_details", "model": spec.name,
799	                                                                     "split": "dev", "evaluation": ev2,
800	                                                                     "purpose": "G0.8 second evaluation"}))
801	    # G0.2 reads the values used: a non-finite value in a used run (N, a selected configuration, S, Y, the G0.8
802	    # re-evaluations) stops the pilot with ST6 before this point; configurations excluded by ST6 during the search
803	    # (section 7: "出现非有限损失或分数的配置剔除") are not used and are listed in the step 7 record ("excluded"). How G0.2
804	    # reads an excluded configuration is for Review Gate (reports/IMPL_C_REPORT.md).
805	    inp = {"leakage": leakage, "all_finite": True, "nonfinite": [], "facts": p.rows["facts.jsonl"], "N": n["summary"],
806	           "repro": repro}
807	    for arm in ("F", "L", "A"):
808	        inp[arm] = {s: runs[_name(arm, selected[arm], s)]["summary"] for s in seeds}
809	    for arm in p.contract.arms.inheriting:
810	        inp[arm] = {s: runs[_name(arm, selected["F"], s)]["summary"] for s in seeds}
811	    values = G.compute_values(inp, p.contract)
812	    judged = G.judge(values, p.contract, p.mode)
813	    comparisons = G.report_comparisons(inp, p.contract, "dev")
814	    s_mapping = {s: {k: inp["S"][s][k] for k in ("s_mapping_dev_learned", "s_mapping_cb")} for s in seeds}
815	    g0_path = p.write(R.GATE0_RECORD, R.gate0_record(p.fz, p.mode, judged))
816	    p.log("Gate 0: %s %s" % (judged["gate0_status"], judged.get("reasons") or judged.get("note") or ""))
817	    rec = {"values": values, "gate0": judged, "comparisons": comparisons, "s_own_mapping": s_mapping,
818	           "excluded": p.excluded, "smoke_stops": p.smoke_stops}
819	    p.step_end(7, rec, [g0_path] + files, "metrix: E1-PILOT formal step 7 (Gate 0 record)")
820	    sat = {c: judged["conditions"][c]["satisfied"] for c in G.CONDITIONS}
821	    p.stop_check(STP.st4, p.fz, sat["G0.7"])
822	    p.stop_check(STP.st5, p.fz, sat["G0.6"])

844	def step8_smoke_refusal(p):
845	    """Smoke, step 8 (Implementation Task Order V1 sections 6 item 9 and 7): the TEST generator, run as run_pilot runs
846	    it (test_generate_command), refuses: RESULT: FAIL, non-zero exit, its --out not created; no TEST file anywhere
847	    under <work>."""
848	    p.step_start(8)
849	    out = p.work / "step8_refused_out"
850	    if out.exists():
851	        raise ImplementationFail("%s exists before the refusal test" % out)
852	    formal = [rel for rel in (R.GATE0_RECORD_REL, R.SELECTION_FREEZE_REL, TG.ST10_RECORD_REL)
853	              if TG._blob(p.root, "HEAD:%s" % rel) is not None or (p.root / rel).exists()]
854	    if formal:                          # there the generator's preconditions may hold: it would generate TEST
855	        raise ImplementationFail("smoke step 8 refused: this checkout holds formal records %s; the refusal test runs "
856	                                 "only where no Gate 0, freeze or ST10 record exists" % formal)
857	    r = subprocess.run(test_generate_command(p, out), cwd=str(p.root), capture_output=True, text=True, check=False,
858	                       env=_subprocess_env())
859	    lines = (r.stdout or "").strip().split("\n")
860	    test_files = sorted(str(x) for n in D.TEST_FILES for x in p.work.rglob(n))
861	    refused = r.returncode != 0 and lines[-1:] == ["RESULT: FAIL"] and not out.exists() and not test_files
862	    rec = {"command": test_generate_command(p, out), "returncode": r.returncode, "stdout": r.stdout,
863	           "stderr": r.stderr, "out_exists": out.exists(), "test_files_under_work": test_files, "refused": refused}
864	    p.log("step 8 (smoke): TEST generator exit %d, last line %r, --out created %s, TEST files %s" % (
865	        r.returncode, lines[-1:], out.exists(), test_files))
866	    p.step_end(8, rec)
867	    if not refused:
868	        raise ImplementationFail("the TEST generator did not refuse in smoke mode")
869	    return rec

957	    """Steps 1-7 (and the step 8 freeze record or the smoke refusal). Returns (status, actual, next, runs)."""

962	    runs = p.runs

965	    step6(p, runs, n_general, selected)
966	    values, judged, _ = step7(p, runs, n, leakage, selected)
967	    seeds = p.contract.training.training_seeds
968	    f101 = runs[_name("F", selected["F"], p.contract.training.search_seed)]["summary"]
969	    actual = {"selected": selected, "gate0": judged, "values": values,

971	                                   "acc_cb": f101["acc_cb"], "acc_dev_learned": f101["acc_dev_learned"]},
972	              "negative_controls": {"G0.6 (S)": values["G0.6"], "G0.7 (Y)": values["G0.7"], "G0.3 (N)": values["G0.3"]},
973	              "runs_completed": len(runs), "training_seeds": seeds,

976	    if p.mode.smoke:
977	        actual["step8"] = step8_smoke_refusal(p)
978	        return judged["gate0_status"], actual, "Review Gate reviews the smoke report (C2)", runs
979	    if judged["gate0_status"] == "PASS":

989	def run_gate(p, command):
990	    """The command formal or smoke: steps 1-7 (+ the step 8 part), then the experiment record (also for a stopped
991	    or crashed run). Returns (completed without a stop, Gate 0 status or the stop's status)."""
992	    crash, gate0 = None, None
993	    try:
994	        p.device_info_record = p.device_check()
995	        if p.mode.formal:                           # the records name the code that ran (testgate.code_commit)
996	            p.code_commit = TG.code_commit(p.root)
997	            p.start_checks(command)
998	        status, actual, nxt, _ = gate_steps(p)
999	        gate0 = actual["gate0"]["gate0_status"]
1000	        stop = None
1001	    except ProtocolStop as e:
1002	        status = e.status or "NOT_TESTED"
1003	        actual, nxt = stopped_actual(p, e), "report to the Owner (stop %s)" % (e.stop,)
1004	        stop = {"code": e.stop, "status": e.status, "message": str(e), "void_pilot": getattr(e, "void_pilot", False)}
1005	        p.log("STOP: %s" % e)
1006	    except Exception as e:           # a crash: the record is written (section 10: stopped runs too), then re-raised
1007	        crash = e                    # (NOT_TESTED: the word for a crash is for Review Gate, reports/IMPL_C_REPORT.md)
1008	        status, actual, nxt = "NOT_TESTED", stopped_actual(p, e), "report to the Owner (the run crashed)"
1009	        stop = {"code": None, "status": None, "message": "crash: %r" % (e,)}
1010	    finally:
1011	        p.close_clock()
1012	    final_record(p, command, status, actual, nxt, p.runs, stop)
1013	    if p.mode.smoke:
1014	        report = smoke_report(p, p.runs, actual)
1015	        p.write("smoke_report.json", report)
1016	        print_smoke_report(p, report)
1017	    if crash is not None:

1029	def final_record(p, command, status, actual, nxt, runs, stop):

1030	    """Write the experiment record; formal: commit and push it. A failing commit or push leaves it in the working
1031	    tree (reported; the Owner decides) and is re-raised only when the run itself did not stop.
1032	    A formal run that stopped before step 1 began (the device check ST8, the code not committed, the commit
1033	    preconditions of step 1) did not start on this machine: its record is written to <work>, outside the repository,
1034	    and nothing is committed (no formal command writes into or pushes from a clone on a machine that is not the
1035	    pilot's); the operator reports it with the log (RUNBOOK_A100.md section 4). This includes ST8 on the A100 host
1036	    (e.g. a 40 GB card), ST12 or ST13 at the start of step 1, the continuity checks (start_checks), and ST12 in
1037	    Pilot() itself (no Pilot, so no record at all: run_pilot.py exits with the traceback). Whether such a record
1038	    belongs in the repository is for Review Gate (protocol section 10; reports/IMPL_C_REPORT.md).
1039	    Records written by the run and not yet committed (a stop or crash inside a step) are committed with it."""
1040	    if p.mode.formal and command == "formal" and not p.step1_started:
1041	        paths = write_experiment_record(p, command, status, actual, nxt, runs, stop, outside_repo=True)
1042	        p.log("experiment record: %s (status %s; the run stopped before step 1: not committed)" % (paths[0], status))
1043	        return paths
1044	    paths = write_experiment_record(p, command, status, actual, nxt, runs, stop)
1045	    p.log("experiment record: %s (status %s)" % (paths[0], status))
1046	    try:
1047	        p.precommit("the experiment record")
1048	        left = [x for x in p.uncommitted if x not in paths]
1049	        p.commit(left + paths, "metrix: E1-PILOT formal %s experiment record (status %s)%s" % (
1050	            command, status, "; %d records of the stopped step" % len(left) if left else ""), "the experiment record")
1051	    except ProtocolStop as e:
1052	        p.log("the experiment record was not committed: %s; it stays in the working tree; report to the Owner" % e)
1053	        if stop is None:
1054	            raise
1055	    return paths

1228	def run_test_evaluate(p):
1229	    """The command test-evaluate. A refusal before the TEST marker exists (a precondition of the generator, the
1230	    continuity checks, a checkpoint file, a committed record, ST7, the commit preconditions checked by begin) leaves
1231	    no experiment record: nothing was evaluated; an ST10 stop (begin's ST10 gate) is a protocol stop and gets one.
1232	    Once the marker exists TEST counts as evaluated, and the experiment record is written and committed whatever
1233	    happens after, a crash included (BLOCKED; the exception is raised again). Returns (completed without a stop,
1234	    final status or the stop's status)."""
1235	    from . import test_data as TD
1236	    crash = None
1237	    try:
1238	        status, actual = test_evaluate(p)
1239	        nxt, stop = "Owner and Review Gate read the TEST result (an E1-V1 protocol only after PASS)", None
1240	    except (ProtocolStop, TD.PreconditionFailed) as e:
1241	        p.close_clock()
1242	        code = getattr(e, "stop", None)
1243	        if not (p.root / TG.MARKER_REL).exists() and code != "ST10":
1244	            p.log("TEST evaluation refused before the TEST marker was written (nothing evaluated): %s" % e)
1245	            return False, getattr(e, "status", None)
1246	        status = getattr(e, "status", None) or "BLOCKED"
1247	        actual, nxt = {"stopped": str(e)}, "report to the Owner (stop %s)" % code
1248	        stop = {"code": code, "status": getattr(e, "status", None), "message": str(e)}
1249	        p.log("STOP (%s): %s" % ("after the TEST marker: TEST counts as evaluated" if code != "ST10" or
1250	                                 (p.root / TG.MARKER_REL).exists() else "ST10, TEST not evaluated", e))
1251	    except Exception as e:           # noqa: BLE001 -- a crash after the marker is recorded, then raised again
1252	        p.close_clock()
1253	        if not (p.root / TG.MARKER_REL).exists():
1254	            raise
1255	        crash = e
1256	        status, actual, nxt = "BLOCKED", {"crashed": repr(e)}, "report to the Owner (crash after the TEST marker)"
1257	        stop = {"code": None, "status": "BLOCKED", "message": "crash after the TEST marker: %r" % (e,)}
1258	        p.log("CRASH after the TEST marker (TEST counts as evaluated): %r" % (e,))
1259	    final_record(p, "test-evaluate", status, actual, nxt, None, stop)
1260	    if crash is not None:
1261	        raise crash

_USERINFO = re.compile(r"([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.-]*://)[^/@\s]*@")


class TestAlreadyEvaluated(Exception):
    """TEST was evaluated (marker and result exist): any further TEST evaluation is refused. Carries no section 9
    status: the pilot's status is the one of its result."""
    __test__ = False        # not a pytest test class


def _git(root, *args):
    return subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(root), *args], capture_output=True, text=True, check=False)


def _blob(root, spec):
    """The bytes of the blob `spec` (<commit>:<path>), or None when there is none."""
    r = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(root), "cat-file", "blob", spec], capture_output=True, check=False)
    return r.stdout if r.returncode == 0 else None


def _refuse(message):
    return ImplementationFail("TEST path refused: %s" % message)


def scrub(text):
    """`text` without the user information of any URL in it (https://user:token@host/... -> https://host/...)."""
    return _USERINFO.sub(r"\1", text)


def _blocked(message):
    return ProtocolStop(None, "BLOCKED", scrub("TEST path refused: %s; report to the Owner" % message))


def _count(v):
    return type(v) is int and v >= 0


    return rec_sha, aud_sha


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ TEST once

def refuse_if_marker(repo_root):
    """Returns when neither a marker nor a result exists (the working tree, the file tree of the remote branch's
    latest commit; check_checkout first). Else raises: a result -> TestAlreadyEvaluated; a marker without a result ->
    the evaluation started and did not finish: it counts as evaluated, BLOCKED (Review Gate supplementary ruling 4)."""
    root = Path(repo_root)
    tip = check_checkout(root)
    where, result = _where(root, MARKER_REL, tip), _where(root, RESULT_REL, tip)
    if result:
        raise TestAlreadyEvaluated("TEST was already evaluated (marker %s in %s; result %s in %s): TEST is evaluated "
                                   "once" % (MARKER_REL, ", ".join(where) or "nowhere", RESULT_REL, ", ".join(result)))
    if not where:
        return
    raise ProtocolStop(None, "BLOCKED", "TEST evaluation was already started (marker %s in %s) and no result was "
                       "committed: it counts as evaluated; no further TEST evaluation; report to the Owner" % (
                           MARKER_REL, ", ".join(where)))


def evaluated_models(contract, selected):
    """The models TEST evaluates: N and the final checkpoints of the trained arms with every training seed (F, L, A
    with their selected configuration, the search seed's run included; S and Y)."""
    from .train import training_plan
    plan = training_plan(contract, selected)
    searched = ("F", "L", "A")
    names = [s.name for s in plan if s.arm in contract.arms.inheriting
             or (s.arm in searched and s.config_id == selected[s.arm])]
    want = len(contract.training.training_seeds) * (len(searched) + len(contract.arms.inheriting))
    if len(names) != want:
        raise ImplementationFail("%d trained models for TEST, expected %d" % (len(names), want))
    return [BASE_MODEL] + names


@dataclass
class TestSession:
    __test__ = False        # not a pytest test class
    session_id: str
    marker_commit: str
    evaluated: set = field(default_factory=set)


_LIVE = {}                  # session_id -> TestSession, only those returned by begin_test_evaluation in this process


def begin_test_evaluation(fz, authorization, data, base_model_sha256, repo_root=None, retries=4, sleep=None):
    """Start the single TEST evaluation (Review Gate supplementary ruling 4): checks (no marker or result:
    refuse_if_marker; the authorization; the ST10 gate for the TEST rows in `data`; check_commit_preconditions),
    writes the marker with every checkpoint hash of the committed freeze record plus N (`base_model_sha256`,
    train.state_sha256 of the loaded base model), commits only the marker and pushes it. Returns the TestSession."""
    from . import contract as C
    root = Path(repo_root) if repo_root is not None else fz.repo_root
    refuse_if_marker(root)
    recs = LK.verify_authorization(authorization, fz, root)
    rows_hashes = rows_hashes_of(data)
    st10_sha, aud_sha = st10_check(fz, authorization, rows_hashes, root)
    if not isinstance(base_model_sha256, str) or not FZ.HEX64.fullmatch(base_model_sha256):
        raise _refuse("base model hash %r" % (base_model_sha256,))
    freeze = recs["selection_freeze"]
    checkpoints = dict(freeze["checkpoints"], **{BASE_MODEL: base_model_sha256})
    models = evaluated_models(C.load(fz), freeze["selected"])
    check_commit_preconditions(root, "the TEST marker")
    session_id = secrets.token_hex(16)
    marker = {"kind": "test_evaluation_marker", "mode": "formal", "frozen_commit": authorization.frozen_commit,
              "authorization": auth_fields(authorization), "remote": remote_url(root, PILOT_REMOTE),
              "branch": PILOT_BRANCH, "st10_record_sha256": st10_sha, "auditor_count_sha256": aud_sha,
              "test_files_sha256": rows_hashes, "checkpoints": checkpoints, "models": models,
              "code_commit": code_commit(root), "session_id": session_id,
              "started_utc": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime())}
    path = root / MARKER_REL
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    blob = (json.dumps(marker, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
    path.write_bytes(blob)
    head = commit_paths(root, [MARKER_REL], "metrix: E1-PILOT TEST evaluation marker (section 8 step 8: TEST is "
                        "evaluated once; every checkpoint hash)",
                        "the TEST marker (TEST not evaluated; the marker refuses any later evaluation)", retries, sleep)
    if _blob(root, "%s:%s" % (head, MARKER_REL)) != blob or _blob(root, "%s^:%s" % (head, MARKER_REL)) is not None:
        raise _blocked("the pushed commit %s does not hold this TEST marker alone (another TEST evaluation began at "
                       "the same time): it counts as evaluated; no TEST evaluation in this process" % head)
    session = TestSession(session_id, head)
    _LIVE[session_id] = session
    return session

"""The single entry point of METRIX E1-PILOT (Implementation Task Order V1, sections 4, 5 and 7; protocol v1.1
section 8, steps 1-8). The steps are in metrix_e1.pilot; RUNBOOK_A100.md gives the command sequence on the A100.

  python run_pilot.py smoke --steps STEPS --inputs DIR --work DIR
        CPU smoke test: steps 1-7 with a random small model of the protocol's class, STEPS optimizer steps per
        training run (fewer than the contract's), step 8 only as the refusal of the TEST generator. Every output is
        labelled SMOKE — NOT A RESULT; nothing is committed; Gate 0 is NOT_TESTED.
  python run_pilot.py formal --inputs DIR --work DIR
        On the A100: steps 1-7 and, when Gate 0 is PASS, the freeze record of step 8; every step's record is
        committed and pushed. There is no step option: the contract's step count is the only one (RunMode refuses a
        shortened count in formal mode).
  python run_pilot.py test-generate --inputs DIR --work DIR
        Step 8, on the Owner's decision: the TEST generator (python -m metrix_e1.test_data) with --out <work>/test.
  python run_pilot.py test-evaluate --inputs DIR --work DIR
        Step 8, after the data-auditor's L6 count is committed: TEST evaluated once.
  python run_pilot.py fetch-model --inputs DIR
        On the A100 host only: the pinned model revision's files into <inputs>/qwen_model.

--inputs is the directory written by `python -m metrix_e1.data fetch` and `python -m metrix_e1.train fetch-config`;
--work is a directory outside the repository. Each command prints RESULT: PASS or RESULT: FAIL; exit 0 only on PASS
(an exception or a stop prints RESULT: FAIL and exits non-zero).
"""
import argparse
import sys
from pathlib import Path

PILOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
SRC = PILOT / "src"
if str(SRC) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(SRC))

from metrix_e1 import mode as M          # noqa: E402
from metrix_e1 import pilot as P         # noqa: E402
from metrix_e1._cli import run_guarded   # noqa: E402


def parser():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="run_pilot.py")
    sub = ap.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)
    a = sub.add_parser("smoke")
    a.add_argument("--steps", type=int, required=True, help="optimizer steps per training run (smoke only)")
    for name in ("smoke", "formal", "test-generate", "test-evaluate"):
        x = a if name == "smoke" else sub.add_parser(name)
        x.add_argument("--inputs", required=True)
        x.add_argument("--work", required=True)
    sub.add_parser("fetch-model").add_argument("--inputs", required=True)
    return ap


def build_mode(args):
    """smoke: RunMode(smoke, --steps); every other command: the formal mode (no shortened step count exists for it)."""
    return M.smoke_mode(args.steps) if args.cmd == "smoke" else M.FORMAL_MODE


def main(argv=None):
    a = parser().parse_args(argv)
    if a.cmd == "fetch-model":
        from metrix_e1 import frozen as FZ
        for name, sha in P.fetch_model(FZ.load(), a.inputs).items():
            print("%-40s sha256 %s (downloaded from the frozen revision)" % (name, sha))
        print("RESULT: PASS")
        sys.exit(0)
    mode = build_mode(a)
    p = P.Pilot(mode, a.inputs, a.work, "cpu" if mode.smoke else "cuda")
    if a.cmd in ("smoke", "formal"):
        ok, status = P.run_gate(p, a.cmd)
        passed = ok and (status == "PASS" or (mode.smoke and status == "NOT_TESTED"))
        print("%s %s: %s" % (a.cmd, "completed" if ok else "stopped", status))
    elif a.cmd == "test-generate":
        passed = P.run_test_generate(p) == 0
    else:
        ok, status = P.run_test_evaluate(p)
        passed = ok and status == "PASS"
        print("test-evaluate %s: %s" % ("completed" if ok else "stopped or refused", status))
    print("RESULT: %s" % ("PASS" if passed else "FAIL"))
    sys.exit(0 if passed else 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_guarded(main)

"""Stop and failure signals of METRIX E1-PILOT.

Protocol v1.1 section 9 (fixed status vocabulary) and section 11 (stop conditions). A ProtocolStop carries the stop
condition (e.g. "ST12") when one applies and the section 9 status the run must be given. Stage B (stops.py) adds the
remaining stop conditions; this module only holds the classes the data side needs.
"""

# Checked against the frozen protocol's section 9 line by contract.check_status_vocabulary (contract.load).
STATUSES = ("PASS", "HYPOTHESIS_FAIL", "IMPLEMENTATION_FAIL", "OPTIMIZATION_FAIL", "CAPACITY_LIMIT",
            "OPTIMIZATION_OR_CAPACITY_UNRESOLVED", "BLOCKED", "NOT_TESTED", "PIPELINE_NOT_QUALIFIED")


class ProtocolStop(Exception):
    """A condition of the protocol that stops the run. `stop` is the section 11 code or None; `status` is a section 9
    status, or None only for ST6 where no status is decided yet (train.NonFinite) or none applies (stops.st6 outside
    the selected configurations and the controls: the run's configuration is excluded from selection)."""

    def __init__(self, stop, status, message):
        if status not in STATUSES and not (status is None and stop == "ST6"):

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Implementation stage C, C2 fix commit (staged tree b40224e6, parent 1900b1fe), round 1 audit: run one command and write
# its complete stdout+stderr (merged) to one file, command line first, exit code last.
#   usage: ic8_run_logged.sh <out_file> <command> [args...]
# PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 (and -B on every python call of these scripts): no .pyc file is written.
# GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0: git status in the pilot repository does not refresh (rewrite) the index file.
# Data Auditor's own script.
out="$1"; shift
export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
export GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0
{
  echo "# Data Auditor run (implementation stage C, C2 fix commit, staged tree b40224e68d1d42f9b4dc886fe9e159f9d99162b1, parent 1900b1fe, round 1). host $(hostname), Anthropic cloud container, CPU only (no GPU device node: $(ls /dev | grep -c '^nvidia') nvidia entries), no model weights loaded (tokenizer files only; smoke checkpoints are hashed as file bytes, never loaded; the Executor's e2e test builds random tiny models in memory); $(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC'); cwd $(pwd)"
  echo "# stdout and stderr merged, complete, unedited"
  printf '$'; printf ' %q' "$@"; echo
  "$@"
  echo "exit=$?"
} > "$out" 2>&1
tail -n 3 "$out"

    ok &= cin == cdiff
    ns = [x for x in g(repo, "diff", "--cached", "--name-status", "HEAD").stdout.split("\n") if x]
    print("   staged paths %d: %s" % (len(ns), sorted(set(x.split("\t")[0] for x in ns))))
    for x in ns:
        if not x.split("\t")[1].startswith(COPY + "training_runs/"):
            print("     " + x)
    print("     (+ %d files under %straining_runs/)" % (sum(1 for x in ns if x.split("\t")[1].startswith(COPY + "training_runs/")), COPY))
    outside = [x for x in ns if not x.split("\t")[1].startswith("metrix/e1-pilot/")]
    print("   staged paths outside metrix/e1-pilot/: %s" % outside)
    ok &= not outside
    code_changed = sorted(x.split("\t")[1] for x in ns if any(x.split("\t")[1].startswith(c) for c in CODE))
    print("   staged code paths (src/, tests/, run_pilot.py): %s" % code_changed)

    q = g(repo, "diff", "--quiet", "--", *CODE).returncode
    print("\nb. working tree == index for %s: %s (git diff --quiet exit %d)" % (CODE, q == 0, q))
    ok &= q == 0
    cd = g(repo, "diff", "--cached", "HEAD", "--", *CODE, text=False).stdout
    print("   sha256 of git diff --cached HEAD -- %s: %s | == %s (c2b_03, c2b_04): %s" % (CODE, sha(cd), CODE_DIFF_SHA[:8],
                                                                                    sha(cd) == CODE_DIFF_SHA))
    ok &= sha(cd) == CODE_DIFF_SHA
    for f in ("c2b_03_checks.txt", "c2b_04_smoke.txt"):
        t = open(os.path.join(repo, "metrix/e1-pilot/reports/impl_c", f), encoding="utf-8").read()
        shas = re.findall(r"^([0-9a-f]{64})  -$", t, re.M)
        trees = re.findall(r"^([0-9a-f]{40})$", t, re.M)
        print("   %s: code diff sha256 lines %s | 40-hex lines %s" % (f, [s[:8] for s in shas], [x[:8] for x in trees]))
        ok &= shas == [CODE_DIFF_SHA, CODE_DIFF_SHA] and SMOKE_TREE in trees

    def code_entries(t):
        return sorted(x for x in g(repo, "ls-tree", "-r", t, "--", *CODE).stdout.split("\n") if x)
    a, b = code_entries(SMOKE_TREE), code_entries(TREE)
    print("\nc. smoke tree %s: %d code entries | staged tree: %d | identical: %s" % (SMOKE_TREE[:8], len(a), len(b), a == b))
    ok &= a == b and len(a) > 0

    copies = [x.split("\t")[1] for x in ns if x.split("\t")[1].startswith(COPY)]
    same, diffr, missing = 0, [], []
    for rel in copies:
        sub = rel[len(COPY):]
        src = os.path.join(work, "records", sub)
        staged = g(repo, "cat-file", "blob", ":" + rel, text=False).stdout
        if not os.path.exists(src):
            missing.append(sub)
            continue
        if open(src, "rb").read() == staged:
            same += 1
        else:
            diffr.append(sub)
    print("\nd. staged copies under %s: %d | byte-identical to %s/records: %d | different %s | not in the smoke's records %s" % (
        COPY, len(copies), work, same, diffr, missing))
    lab = os.path.join(repo, COPY + "LABEL.txt")
    print("   LABEL.txt of the copy directory: %r" % open(lab, encoding="utf-8").read())
    ok &= not diffr and missing == ["LABEL.txt"] and same == len(copies) - 1
    smoke_recs = sorted(os.path.relpath(os.path.join(d, f), os.path.join(work, "records"))
                        for d, _, fs in os.walk(os.path.join(work, "records")) for f in fs)
    not_copied = sorted(set(smoke_recs) - {c[len(COPY):] for c in copies})
    print("   smoke records not copied (expected: the per-question details only): %d, all under details/: %s" % (
        len(not_copied), all(x.startswith("details/") for x in not_copied)))
    ok &= all(x.startswith("details/") for x in not_copied)

    for d in DRAFTS:
        st = [x for x in g(repo, "status", "--porcelain", "--", d).stdout.split("\n") if x]
        in_idx = g(repo, "cat-file", "-e", ":" + d).returncode == 0
        print("\ne. %s status %s | in the index %s (expected untracked '??', not staged)" % (d, st, in_idx))
        ok &= st == ["?? " + d] and not in_idx
    return bool(ok)

# Mythos 项目宪章 v2.0(2026-11-08)

**本文件取代宪章 v1.0。** 与 v1.0、旧 checkpoint 或旧 PROTOCOL 文件冲突时,以本文件和 `research/mini_mythos/PROJECT_BRIEF.md` 为准。历史文件保留不改,但不再约束新工作。

## 1. 方向

- 底座是 Parcae-140M 预训练权重(`SandyResearch/parcae-140m@236739ce`)。我们不再从随机初始化训练自己的权重。
- 最终的 Mythos 是 **Parcae 的派生模型**(Parcae 权重 + 我们的机制/适配器),不是独立权重。Parcae 权重和分词器的许可证未确认,确认前不对外分发任何权重或派生模型。
- 目标:用实验证明“Parcae + 机制”优于原生 Parcae,即同等计算下质量更高,或相近质量下计算更少。不宣称复刻 Claude Mythos。

## 2. 分工与关闭

| 角色 | 职责 |
|---|---|
| 项目负责人 | 定方向、定预算、批准进入下一阶段、宣布 CLOSED |
| Claude Project(策略) | 设计和审核实验方案、解读结果 |
| Claude Code(执行) | 写代码、测试、运行、提交结果和 checkpoint |

不再要求 ChatGPT 或 Grok 交叉审核。阶段由负责人在看过结果后宣布 CLOSED。

## 3. 每个实验的最低要求

1. 一页方案,写在实验目录的 `README.md`:目的、数据、对照、主指标、通过标准、算力和时间上限、停止条件。
2. 方案提交后再运行;看到结果后不改通过标准。
3. 状态如实标注:PASS / FAIL / BLOCKED / NOT TESTED。负结果也是结果。
4. **同预算对照**:可训练参数量相同、训练 token 数相同、学习率等超参搜索次数相同。只有优于这个对照,才算机制有效。
5. **新数据**:主结论必须来自训练和调参都没用过的数据,至少包含一个异领域集;并抽样检查它与预训练语料的 n-gram 重叠。
6. 每次只加一个机制;组合要等单项都在新数据上通过。
7. 评测输入与预训练一致:**不加 BOS/EOS**,窗口从文档开头取。Parcae 预训练(`pqds-pure` + best-fit 打包)不加任何特殊 token,实测加 BOS 会明显变差(见 `research/mini_mythos/stage0/STAGE0_REVIEW.md`)。BOS 只作对照。

## 4. 流程要轻

- 证据保留到“别人能复核”为止:代码 commit、配置、数据锁定文件(版本 + sha256)、随机种子、汇总结果、每样本结果。大文件留在运行机器上,不进 Git。
- 不对历史文件做逐个哈希保护;不为每个实验重写启动器和守卫。
- 允许中断后续跑,只要配置不变且如实记录。修了 bug 可以重跑,但要在 checkpoint 里写明原因和前后差异。
- 路径或导入类问题 30 分钟内修不好,就停下报告;算力超过方案上限,就停下报告进度。
- checkpoint 一页以内:做了什么、结果、commit SHA、未解决问题、下一步。

## 5. 不要做

- 不修改上游 Parcae(`sandyresearch/parcae@69284c13`,只读)。
- 不操作 PR #24(D1 Draft,保留不合并)。
- 不把开发集上的收益写成“机制有效”。
- 不在方案外使用 GPU;GPU 租用由负责人批准。

## 6. Metrix 子项目(2026-11-13 负责人决定)

Metrix 是独立子项目,不属于 Mythos 方向。`metrix/` 下的工作以 `metrix/CLAUDE.md` 为准:

- 本宪章第 1 节(Parcae 底座、派生模型目标)和第 3.7 节(不加 BOS/EOS)**不适用于 Metrix**。Metrix 使用 Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B,打分按其 chat template 构造输入。
- 第 5 节「不要做」的各条继续适用于 Metrix。
- 其余条款与 `metrix/CLAUDE.md` 冲突时,在 `metrix/` 内以 `metrix/CLAUDE.md` 为准。

@metrix/CLAUDE.md

# Metrix — 角色分工与执行规则

Metrix 是独立子项目。根目录 `CLAUDE.md`(Mythos 宪章 v2.0)第 1 节与第 3.7 节不适用于 Metrix;第 5 节「不要做」继续适用。在 `metrix/` 内,本文件与宪章冲突时以本文件为准。

本文件的修改须经 Review Gate 裁决、Project Owner 批准,并记录原因与时间。

## 1. 角色

| 角色 | 由谁担任 | 职责 | 不做 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Project Owner | Miyaji | 拍板重大事项;批准租卡与预算;在 Review Gate 与 Claude Code 之间转达 | 日常审查、代码细节 |
| Review Gate(总管) | claude.ai Project「Metrix」 | 总体设计、协议审阅、Gate 裁决、下达编号指令、维护决定记录 | 写代码、跑命令、替 Owner 拍板 |
| Executor | Claude Code 主会话 | 写代码、运行、提交、写 SUBMISSION_NOTE、调用两个审查 subagent | 改协议、审查自己的产物、推翻审查结论 |
| Code Reviewer | subagent `code-reviewer` | 查 bug、死代码、可读性、合理性、与协议的一致性 | 修改任何文件 |
| Data Auditor | subagent `data-auditor` | 用自写脚本独立复算哈希、L1–L6 泄漏、候选可行性、split | 复用 Executor 的检查代码、加载模型权重 |

重大事项(只有 Owner 能批准):研究方向、模型、arm 结构、门槛数值、PROTOCOL_FROZEN、TEST 评测时机、租用 GPU、冻结后的协议改动、删除文件、改写 Git 历史。

## 2. 当前阶段

- E1 Pilot,状态:PROTOCOL_FROZEN（v1.1）（出处：Review Gate 第 8 轮裁决，Owner 批准，2026-11-22 09:44 UTC；作用范围：本阶段（Owner 在第 9 轮答复，见 metrix/e1-pilot/tasks/ROUND9_TASKS.md 第二段）；原因：协议已冻结并发布 v1.1 勘误版，原状态未随冻结更新，见 metrix/e1-pilot/reports/ROUND8_REPORT.md「待 Review Gate 决定」第 9 项）
- 分支:metrix-e1-pilot-protocol-v1
- 基线:leotree2020/OpenMythos mythos-idea-thermo-v1 @ 61d3c76705b28cc2ee334abc5bf1baaac4fc30dc
- 模型:Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B @ 70d244cc86ccca08cf5af4e1e306ecf908b1ad5e
- 工作目录:metrix/e1-pilot/。metrix/ 以外只允许:根目录 CLAUDE.md 第 6 节、.claude/agents/ 下的两个 subagent 文件。

## 3. 硬性禁止(收到 PROTOCOL_FROZEN 之前)

- 不训练、不评测、不生成或读取 TEST 数据。
- 不在 CPU 环境加载真实模型权重。CPU 只做模板、tokenizer、哈希、泄漏检查,以及用随机初始化的同构小模型做冒烟测试。
- 汇报时写明实际运行环境(主机名或环境类型),不要笼统称为「本地」。

## 4. 算力

- 训练与评测只在单张 A100 80GB 上执行,上限 4 小时。首次运行记录设备全名,同一次 Pilot 内必须一致,否则整批作废。
- 环境、下载、冒烟测试先在 CPU 环境完成;租卡后只跑正式流程。预检预估总时长超过 3.5 小时即停（协议 ST11）；累计 GPU 时间超过 4 小时即停（协议 ST7）。（出处：Review Gate 第 8 轮裁决，Owner 批准，2026-11-22 09:44 UTC；作用范围：本阶段；只替换本条原末句「实测预计超过 3 小时即停下报告。」，本节其余文字不变（作用范围与替换范围均为 Owner 在第 9 轮答复，见 metrix/e1-pilot/tasks/ROUND9_TASKS.md 第二段）；原因：原 3 小时与协议 ST11 的 3.5 小时不一致，见 metrix/e1-pilot/reports/ROUND8_REPORT.md「待 Review Gate 决定」第 6 项）

## 5. 自动审查循环

1. 每次提交前调用 `code-reviewer`。
2. 改动涉及数据、split、候选集、打分或评测代码时,再调用 `data-auditor`。
3. 任一结论为 BLOCK:修复后重新调用。不得跳过审查,不得改写或摘要替代审查原文。
4. 连续 3 轮未 PASS:停止,提交当前状态与全部审查原始输出,等待 Review Gate。
5. 审查原始输出保存到 `metrix/e1-pilot/reviews/<commit-hash>/`,随提交推送。
6. 每次调用审查 subagent,调用文字的第一句固定为:「先读仓库中的 .claude/agents/<名称>.md，以它为你的完整定义；它与你已加载的定义冲突时，以仓库文件为准。」调用前比对仓库文件与已加载定义的 frontmatter;两个版本的 tools 行不一致时必须停下,不得用此方法替代。（出处：Review Gate 第 7 轮裁决，Owner 批准，本阶段，2026-11-22 03:25:59 UTC）

## 6. PR 审查

- 改动经 PR 合入,不直接推送到受保护分支。
- PR 自动审查与本地 subagent 结论不一致时,以更严格的一方为准,并在 PR 中说明。

## 7. 必须等待人工指令的事项

PROTOCOL_FROZEN 的发出与修改、租用 GPU、生成或评测 TEST、删除任何文件、改写 Git 历史、force push。

注：「删除任何文件」不含会话临时目录；但支撑结论的输出须先提交。

## 8. 冲突处理

- Reviewer / Auditor 与 Executor 意见不同:由 Review Gate 裁决。
- 协议未覆盖的情况:停止并报告,由 Review Gate 提出方案。
- Review Gate 的裁决写入决定记录时须注明作用范围:本次提交 / 本阶段 / 永久。「永久」与「本阶段」的裁决可写入本文件,写入时须注明作用范围;「本阶段」的裁决在本阶段结束时失效。（出处：Review Gate 第 7 轮裁决（第 8 轮指令第 1e 项），Owner 批准，2026-11-22 05:27 UTC；原因：原文只允许「永久」的裁决写入本文件，与已写入的第 5 节第 6 条、第 10 节的「本阶段」裁决矛盾，见 metrix/e1-pilot/reports/ROUND7_REPORT.md「待 Review Gate 决定」第 4 项）（作用范围：永久。出处：Review Gate 第 8 轮裁决，Owner 批准，2026-11-22 09:44 UTC；原因：1e 写入时未注明这条裁决自己的作用范围，见 metrix/e1-pilot/reports/ROUND8_REPORT.md「待 Review Gate 决定」第 1 项）

## 9. 汇报格式

- commit hash 与报告路径。
- 两份审查的原始输出路径与结论。
- 所有结论附原始命令输出。自检勾选不算证据。
- 原始输出一律写入仓库并推送，不留在临时目录；data-auditor 须提交 audit 脚本的完整 stdout。（出处：Review Gate 第 4 轮裁决，Owner 批准，永久）

# Metrix — 角色分工与执行规则

Metrix 是独立子项目。根目录 `CLAUDE.md`(Mythos 宪章 v2.0)第 1 节与第 3.7 节不适用于 Metrix;第 5 节「不要做」继续适用。在 `metrix/` 内,本文件与宪章冲突时以本文件为准。

本文件的修改须经 Review Gate 裁决、Project Owner 批准,并记录原因与时间。

## 1. 角色

| 角色 | 由谁担任 | 职责 | 不做 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Project Owner | Miyaji | 拍板重大事项;批准租卡与预算;在 Review Gate 与 Claude Code 之间转达 | 日常审查、代码细节 |
| Review Gate(总管) | claude.ai Project「Metrix」 | 总体设计、协议审阅、Gate 裁决、下达编号指令、维护决定记录 | 写代码、跑命令、替 Owner 拍板 |
| Executor | Claude Code 主会话 | 写代码、运行、提交、写 SUBMISSION_NOTE、调用两个审查 subagent | 改协议、审查自己的产物、推翻审查结论 |
| Code Reviewer | subagent `code-reviewer` | 查 bug、死代码、可读性、合理性、与协议的一致性 | 修改任何文件 |
| Data Auditor | subagent `data-auditor` | 用自写脚本独立复算哈希、L1–L6 泄漏、候选可行性、split | 复用 Executor 的检查代码、加载模型权重 |

重大事项(只有 Owner 能批准):研究方向、模型、arm 结构、门槛数值、PROTOCOL_FROZEN、TEST 评测时机、租用 GPU、冻结后的协议改动、删除文件、改写 Git 历史。

## 2. 当前阶段

- E1 Pilot,状态:PROTOCOL_FROZEN（v1.1）（出处：Review Gate 第 8 轮裁决，Owner 批准，2026-11-22 09:44 UTC；作用范围：本阶段（Owner 在第 9 轮答复，见 metrix/e1-pilot/tasks/ROUND9_TASKS.md 第二段）；原因：协议已冻结并发布 v1.1 勘误版，原状态未随冻结更新，见 metrix/e1-pilot/reports/ROUND8_REPORT.md「待 Review Gate 决定」第 9 项）
- 分支:metrix-e1-pilot-protocol-v1
- 基线:leotree2020/OpenMythos mythos-idea-thermo-v1 @ 61d3c76705b28cc2ee334abc5bf1baaac4fc30dc
- 模型:Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B @ 70d244cc86ccca08cf5af4e1e306ecf908b1ad5e
- 工作目录:metrix/e1-pilot/。metrix/ 以外只允许:根目录 CLAUDE.md 第 6 节、.claude/agents/ 下的两个 subagent 文件。

## 3. 硬性禁止(收到 PROTOCOL_FROZEN 之前)

- 不训练、不评测、不生成或读取 TEST 数据。
- 不在 CPU 环境加载真实模型权重。CPU 只做模板、tokenizer、哈希、泄漏检查,以及用随机初始化的同构小模型做冒烟测试。
- 汇报时写明实际运行环境(主机名或环境类型),不要笼统称为「本地」。

## 4. 算力

- 训练与评测只在单张 A100 80GB 上执行,上限 4 小时。首次运行记录设备全名,同一次 Pilot 内必须一致,否则整批作废。
- 环境、下载、冒烟测试先在 CPU 环境完成;租卡后只跑正式流程。预检预估总时长超过 3.5 小时即停（协议 ST11）；累计 GPU 时间超过 4 小时即停（协议 ST7）。（出处：Review Gate 第 8 轮裁决，Owner 批准，2026-11-22 09:44 UTC；作用范围：本阶段；只替换本条原末句「实测预计超过 3 小时即停下报告。」，本节其余文字不变（作用范围与替换范围均为 Owner 在第 9 轮答复，见 metrix/e1-pilot/tasks/ROUND9_TASKS.md 第二段）；原因：原 3 小时与协议 ST11 的 3.5 小时不一致，见 metrix/e1-pilot/reports/ROUND8_REPORT.md「待 Review Gate 决定」第 6 项）

## 5. 自动审查循环

1. 每次提交前调用 `code-reviewer`。
2. 改动涉及数据、split、候选集、打分或评测代码时,再调用 `data-auditor`。
3. 任一结论为 BLOCK:修复后重新调用。不得跳过审查,不得改写或摘要替代审查原文。
4. 连续 3 轮未 PASS:停止,提交当前状态与全部审查原始输出,等待 Review Gate。
5. 审查原始输出保存到 `metrix/e1-pilot/reviews/<commit-hash>/`,随提交推送。
6. 每次调用审查 subagent,调用文字的第一句固定为:「先读仓库中的 .claude/agents/<名称>.md，以它为你的完整定义；它与你已加载的定义冲突时，以仓库文件为准。」调用前比对仓库文件与已加载定义的 frontmatter;两个版本的 tools 行不一致时必须停下,不得用此方法替代。（出处：Review Gate 第 7 轮裁决，Owner 批准，本阶段，2026-11-22 03:25:59 UTC）

## 6. PR 审查

- 改动经 PR 合入,不直接推送到受保护分支。
- PR 自动审查与本地 subagent 结论不一致时,以更严格的一方为准,并在 PR 中说明。

## 7. 必须等待人工指令的事项

PROTOCOL_FROZEN 的发出与修改、租用 GPU、生成或评测 TEST、删除任何文件、改写 Git 历史、force push。

注：「删除任何文件」不含会话临时目录；但支撑结论的输出须先提交。

## 8. 冲突处理

- Reviewer / Auditor 与 Executor 意见不同:由 Review Gate 裁决。
- 协议未覆盖的情况:停止并报告,由 Review Gate 提出方案。
- Review Gate 的裁决写入决定记录时须注明作用范围:本次提交 / 本阶段 / 永久。「永久」与「本阶段」的裁决可写入本文件,写入时须注明作用范围;「本阶段」的裁决在本阶段结束时失效。（出处：Review Gate 第 7 轮裁决（第 8 轮指令第 1e 项），Owner 批准，2026-11-22 05:27 UTC；原因：原文只允许「永久」的裁决写入本文件，与已写入的第 5 节第 6 条、第 10 节的「本阶段」裁决矛盾，见 metrix/e1-pilot/reports/ROUND7_REPORT.md「待 Review Gate 决定」第 4 项）（作用范围：永久。出处：Review Gate 第 8 轮裁决，Owner 批准，2026-11-22 09:44 UTC；原因：1e 写入时未注明这条裁决自己的作用范围，见 metrix/e1-pilot/reports/ROUND8_REPORT.md「待 Review Gate 决定」第 1 项）

## 9. 汇报格式

- commit hash 与报告路径。
- 两份审查的原始输出路径与结论。
- 所有结论附原始命令输出。自检勾选不算证据。

"""ic7_06 (implementation stage C, C2 work commit (staged tree b80c9062, parent f8139f9), round 1; supplementary to tasks
1-5): the smoke outputs are labelled and carry no Gate 0 conclusion (Implementation Task Order V1 section 7).
  - every JSON file under <smoke>/records (step, run, details, Gate 0, smoke report, experiment record) has
    label "SMOKE — NOT A RESULT" and mode "smoke"; every .txt record starts with the label line; data/, checkpoints/,
    preflight/ each hold LABEL.txt with the label;
  - gate0_record: gate0_status NOT_TESTED with the note 冒烟测试，不构成结论, all ten conditions G0.1-G0.10 computed;
    experiment record Status NOT_TESTED; "smoke: device check skipped" recorded (step 1 record, smoke report);
  - the smoke's recorded "would stop" entries are exactly the value stops whose condition holds by the recorded values:
    ST3 (positive control: Acc_CB below the ST3 bound or Acc(F, DEV-QA, learned) below it; bounds read from the frozen
    protocol's ST3 / G0.4 / G0.5 text), ST11 (preflight estimate above the ST11 hours of the frozen protocol), and not
    ST2 / ST4 / ST5 (G0.3, G0.7, G0.6 satisfied in the smoke Gate 0 record).
Data Auditor's own script; nothing of the Executor is imported.
usage: python -I -B ic7_06_smoke_labels.py <repo_root> <smoke_work_dir>"""
import os
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import json
import re
from ia_common import frozen_protocol, run

LABEL = "SMOKE — NOT A RESULT"


def main():
    repo, work = sys.argv[1:3]
    rec = os.path.join(work, "records")
    ok = True
    js, txt = [], []
    for d, _, fs in os.walk(rec):
        for f in fs:
            (js if f.endswith(".json") else txt).append(os.path.join(d, f))
    bad = []
    for p in js:
        o = json.load(open(p, encoding="utf-8"))
        if o.get("label") != LABEL or o.get("mode") != "smoke":
            bad.append((os.path.relpath(p, rec), o.get("label"), o.get("mode")))
    badt = [os.path.relpath(p, rec) for p in txt if open(p, encoding="utf-8").read().split("\n")[0] != LABEL]
    print("JSON records %d, without the SMOKE label or mode smoke: %s | text records %d %s, first line not the label: %s" % (
        len(js), bad, len(txt), [os.path.relpath(p, rec) for p in txt], badt))
    ok &= not bad and not badt and len(js) > 0
    for d in ("data", "checkpoints", "preflight"):
        lab = open(os.path.join(work, d, "LABEL.txt"), encoding="utf-8").read()
        print("  %s/LABEL.txt %r" % (d, lab))
        ok &= lab == LABEL + "\n"
    g0 = json.load(open(os.path.join(rec, "gate0_record.json"), encoding="utf-8"))["gate0"]
    conds = sorted(g0["conditions"], key=lambda c: int(c.split(".")[1]))
    print("gate0_status %r note %r | conditions %s" % (g0["gate0_status"], g0.get("note"), conds))
    ok &= g0["gate0_status"] == "NOT_TESTED" and g0.get("note") == "冒烟测试，不构成结论" and conds == ["G0.%d" % i for i in range(1, 11)]
    ex = json.load(open(os.path.join(rec, "experiment_record_smoke.json"), encoding="utf-8"))["template"]
    print("experiment record Status %r Interpretation %r | template fields %d" % (ex["Status"], ex["Interpretation"], len(ex)))
    ok &= ex["Status"] == "NOT_TESTED" and len(ex) == 20
    s1 = json.load(open(os.path.join(rec, "step1_record.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
    sr = json.load(open(os.path.join(rec, "smoke_report.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
    print("device note: step1_record %r | smoke_report %r" % (s1["device"], sr["device_note"]))
    ok &= s1["device"] == "smoke: device check skipped" == sr["device_note"]

    prot = frozen_protocol(repo)
    st3 = [ln for ln in prot.split("\n") if ln.startswith("| ST3 |")][0]
    st11 = [ln for ln in prot.split("\n") if ln.startswith("| ST11 |")][0]
    cb_min, acc_min = [float(x) for x in re.findall(r"< (0\.\d+)", st3)]
    hours = float(re.search(r"超过 ([\d.]+) 小时", st11).group(1))
    print("frozen protocol: %s\n                 %s\n  -> ST3 bounds Acc_CB %s, Acc %s | ST11 hours %s" % (st3, st11, cb_min, acc_min, hours))
    s4 = json.load(open(os.path.join(rec, "step4_record.json"), encoding="utf-8"))["positive_control"]
    pre = json.load(open(os.path.join(rec, "step2_record.json"), encoding="utf-8"))["preflight"]
    sat = {c: x["satisfied"] for c, x in g0["conditions"].items()}
    want = sorted((["ST3"] if s4["acc_cb"] < cb_min or s4["acc_dev_learned"] < acc_min else [])
                  + (["ST11"] if pre["estimate_total_hours"] > hours else [])
                  + (["ST2"] if not sat["G0.3"] else []) + (["ST4"] if not sat["G0.7"] else [])
                  + (["ST5"] if not sat["G0.6"] else []))
    got = sorted(x["stop"] for x in sr["smoke_recorded_stops"])
    print("positive control acc_cb %s acc_dev_learned %s (step4 st3 %r) | preflight estimate %.3f h (step2 st11 %r) | G0.3 %s "
          "G0.6 %s G0.7 %s" % (s4["acc_cb"], s4["acc_dev_learned"], s4["st3"], pre["estimate_total_hours"], pre["st11"],
                               sat["G0.3"], sat["G0.6"], sat["G0.7"]))
    print("recorded 'would stop' %s == expected from the recorded values %s: %s | every entry labelled: %s" % (
        got, want, got == want, all(x["label"] == LABEL for x in sr["smoke_recorded_stops"])))
    ok &= got == want and all(x["label"] == LABEL for x in sr["smoke_recorded_stops"])
    return bool(ok)


run(main)

    for k in c.keywords:
        if k.arg == name:
            return ast.unparse(k.value)
    return None


def enclosing_functions(tree):
    out = {}

    def visit(n, fn):
        if isinstance(n, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
            fn = n.name
        if isinstance(n, ast.Call):
            out[id(n)] = fn
        for ch in ast.iter_child_nodes(n):
            visit(ch, fn)
    visit(tree, None)
    return out

"""ic8_04 trace plugin (implementation stage C, C2 fix commit, round 1; task 3 of the invocation). Data Auditor's own code;
my ic7_04_trace_plugin.py extended for the changed code.

A pytest plugin loaded with `-p ic8_04_trace_plugin` while the Executor's test
tests/test_run_pilot.py::test_test_evaluate_end_to_end_once runs as a driver subprocess (C1 ruling item 5). It does not
check anything: it only records, in the JSONL file named by the environment variable IC8_TRACE, every call (enter /
return / raise) of the functions on the TEST evaluation path, so that my own analysis script (ic8_04_e2e.py, which
imports nothing of the Executor) can compare the observed order with the order I expected before the run. The wrappers
pass arguments and results through unchanged.

Observed (module or class attribute replaced by a pass-through wrapper after collection, before the fixture runs):
  metrix_e1.pilot: run_test_evaluate, test_evaluate, final_record, write_experiment_record (the paths it returns),
    control_evaluation, test_evaluation_seconds (its timing argument and result), Pilot.start_checks (the command);
  metrix_e1.record: committed_json, committed_record (the path read);
  metrix_e1.train.state_sha256 (the hash returned; testgate.require_test_session imports it at call time);
  metrix_e1.test_data.check_preconditions; metrix_e1.frozen.file_sha256 (only paths ending in .pt are logged);
  metrix_e1.testgate: begin_test_evaluation (its base-model hash argument), claim_checkpoint, commit_paths,
    finish_test_evaluation; metrix_e1.evaluate.evaluate_model; metrix_e1.gate: compute_test_values, judge_test,
    report_comparisons.
At the start of the test call (after the fixture; tryfirst) the plugin logs the clone, the bare remote, the work
directory, the models of the fixture, the remote's tip and the Pilot's start time (p.started, the experiment record's
file name), and wraps the fixture's own `p.before_run` (a no-op lambda the fixture installed) with a pass-through that
logs its next_seconds argument: the call and its result are unchanged.

Fault injection (IC8_FAULT, empty by default): "stop_after_marker" raises a ProtocolStop(None, "BLOCKED", ...) and
"crash_after_marker" a RuntimeError when evaluate_model(split="test") is entered for the 3rd time (after the marker was
pushed and two models were evaluated).
"""
import json
import os
import subprocess

import pytest

TRACE = os.environ.get("IC8_TRACE")
FAULT = os.environ.get("IC8_FAULT", "")
_STATE = {"installed": False, "test_evals": 0, "seq": 0}


def _log(ev):
    _STATE["seq"] += 1
    ev = dict(ev, seq=_STATE["seq"])
    with open(TRACE, "a", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        fh.write(json.dumps(ev, default=str, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")


def _short(v):
    s = repr(v)
    return s if len(s) <= 300 else s[:300] + "..."


def _wrap(owner, name, describe=None, result=None, only=None, label=None):
    orig = getattr(owner, name)
    label = label or name

    def wrapper(*a, **k):
        if only is not None and not only(a, k):
            return orig(*a, **k)
        info = describe(a, k) if describe else {}
        _log(dict({"call": label, "phase": "enter"}, **info))
        if name == "evaluate_model" and k.get("split") == "test":
            _STATE["test_evals"] += 1
            if FAULT and _STATE["test_evals"] == 3:
                if FAULT == "stop_after_marker":
                    from metrix_e1.errors import ProtocolStop
                    exc = ProtocolStop(None, "BLOCKED", "auditor-injected stop after the TEST marker (ic8 fault "
                                       "injection, 3rd TEST evaluation)")
                else:
                    exc = RuntimeError("auditor-injected crash after the TEST marker (ic8 fault injection, 3rd TEST "
                                       "evaluation)")
                _log({"call": label, "phase": "injected", "fault": FAULT, "exc": type(exc).__name__})
                raise exc
        try:
            r = orig(*a, **k)
        except BaseException as e:      # noqa: B902 -- logged and re-raised unchanged
            _log({"call": label, "phase": "raise", "exc": type(e).__name__, "msg": str(e)[:400]})
            raise
        _log(dict({"call": label, "phase": "return"}, **(result(r) if result else {})))
        return r
    wrapper.__wrapped_by_ic8__ = orig
    setattr(owner, name, wrapper)


def _install():
    if _STATE["installed"]:
        return
    import metrix_e1.evaluate as E
    import metrix_e1.frozen as FZ
    import metrix_e1.gate as G
    import metrix_e1.pilot as P
    import metrix_e1.record as R
    import metrix_e1.test_data as TD
    import metrix_e1.testgate as TG
    import metrix_e1.train as T
    _wrap(P, "run_test_evaluate", result=lambda r: {"result": _short(r)})
    _wrap(P, "test_evaluate", result=lambda r: {"result": _short(r[0])})
    _wrap(P, "final_record", describe=lambda a, k: {"command": a[1], "status": a[2], "stop": a[6] if len(a) > 6 else k.get("stop")})
    _wrap(P, "write_experiment_record", result=lambda r: {"paths": [os.path.basename(str(x)) for x in r]})
    _wrap(P, "control_evaluation", describe=lambda a, k: {"what": a[2], "split": k.get("split", "dev")})
    _wrap(P, "test_evaluation_seconds", describe=lambda a, k: {"timing": a[1]}, result=lambda r: {"seconds": r})
    _wrap(P.Pilot, "start_checks", describe=lambda a, k: {"command": a[1]}, label="Pilot.start_checks")
    _wrap(R, "committed_json", describe=lambda a, k: {"rel": str(a[1])}, label="R.committed_json")
    _wrap(R, "committed_record", describe=lambda a, k: {"rel": str(a[1])}, label="R.committed_record")
    _wrap(T, "state_sha256", result=lambda r: {"sha256": r}, label="T.state_sha256")
    _wrap(TD, "check_preconditions")
    _wrap(FZ, "file_sha256", describe=lambda a, k: {"file": os.path.basename(str(a[0]))}, result=lambda r: {"sha256": r},
          only=lambda a, k: str(a[0]).endswith(".pt"))
    _wrap(TG, "begin_test_evaluation", describe=lambda a, k: {"base_sha256": a[3] if len(a) > 3 else k.get("base_model_sha256")},
          result=lambda r: {"marker_commit": getattr(r, "marker_commit", None)})
    _wrap(TG, "claim_checkpoint", describe=lambda a, k: {"checkpoint": a[1]})
    _wrap(TG, "commit_paths", describe=lambda a, k: {"rels": list(a[1])}, result=lambda r: {"head": r})
    _wrap(TG, "finish_test_evaluation", result=lambda r: {"head": r})
    _wrap(E, "evaluate_model", describe=lambda a, k: {"split": k.get("split", "dev"),
                                                      "checkpoint": k.get("checkpoint_name")})
    _wrap(G, "compute_test_values")
    _wrap(G, "judge_test", result=lambda r: {"final_status": r.get("final_status")})
    _wrap(G, "report_comparisons", describe=lambda a, k: {"split": a[2] if len(a) > 2 else k.get("split")})
    _STATE["installed"] = True
    _log({"call": "plugin", "phase": "installed", "fault": FAULT})


def pytest_collection_finish(session):
    _install()


@pytest.hookimpl(tryfirst=True)
def pytest_runtest_call(item):
    c = item.funcargs.get("eval_clone")
    if c is None:
        return
    p = c["p"]
    orig = p.before_run

    def before_run(next_seconds=0.0):
        _log({"call": "p.before_run", "phase": "enter", "next_seconds": next_seconds})

tests/test_run_pilot.py::test_test_evaluate_end_to_end_once runs as a driver subprocess (C1 ruling item 5). It does not
check anything: it only records, in the JSONL file named by the environment variable IC8_TRACE, every call (enter /
return / raise) of the functions on the TEST evaluation path, so that my own analysis script (ic8_04_e2e.py, which
imports nothing of the Executor) can compare the observed order with the order I expected before the run. The wrappers
pass arguments and results through unchanged.

Observed (module or class attribute replaced by a pass-through wrapper after collection, before the fixture runs):
  metrix_e1.pilot: run_test_evaluate, test_evaluate, final_record, write_experiment_record (the paths it returns),
    control_evaluation, test_evaluation_seconds (its timing argument and result), Pilot.start_checks (the command);
  metrix_e1.record: committed_json, committed_record (the path read);
  metrix_e1.train.state_sha256 (the hash returned; testgate.require_test_session imports it at call time);
  metrix_e1.test_data.check_preconditions; metrix_e1.frozen.file_sha256 (only paths ending in .pt are logged);
  metrix_e1.testgate: begin_test_evaluation (its base-model hash argument), claim_checkpoint, commit_paths,
    finish_test_evaluation; metrix_e1.evaluate.evaluate_model; metrix_e1.gate: compute_test_values, judge_test,
    report_comparisons.
At the start of the test call (after the fixture; tryfirst) the plugin logs the clone, the bare remote, the work
directory, the models of the fixture, the remote's tip and the Pilot's start time (p.started, the experiment record's
file name), and wraps the fixture's own `p.before_run` (a no-op lambda the fixture installed) with a pass-through that
logs its next_seconds argument: the call and its result are unchanged.

Fault injection (IC8_FAULT, empty by default): "stop_after_marker" raises a ProtocolStop(None, "BLOCKED", ...) and
"crash_after_marker" a RuntimeError when evaluate_model(split="test") is entered for the 3rd time (after the marker was
pushed and two models were evaluated).

import json
import os
import subprocess

import pytest

TRACE = os.environ.get("IC8_TRACE")
FAULT = os.environ.get("IC8_FAULT", "")
_STATE = {"installed": False, "test_evals": 0, "seq": 0}


def _log(ev):
    _STATE["seq"] += 1
    ev = dict(ev, seq=_STATE["seq"])
    with open(TRACE, "a", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        fh.write(json.dumps(ev, default=str, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")


def _short(v):
    s = repr(v)
    return s if len(s) <= 300 else s[:300] + "..."


def _wrap(owner, name, describe=None, result=None, only=None, label=None):
    orig = getattr(owner, name)
    label = label or name

    def wrapper(*a, **k):
        if only is not None and not only(a, k):
            return orig(*a, **k)
        info = describe(a, k) if describe else {}
        _log(dict({"call": label, "phase": "enter"}, **info))
        if name == "evaluate_model" and k.get("split") == "test":
            _STATE["test_evals"] += 1
            if FAULT and _STATE["test_evals"] == 3:
                if FAULT == "stop_after_marker":

                    exc = ProtocolStop(None, "BLOCKED", "auditor-injected stop after the TEST marker (ic8 fault "
                                       "injection, 3rd TEST evaluation)")
                else:
                    exc = RuntimeError("auditor-injected crash after the TEST marker (ic8 fault injection, 3rd TEST "
                                       "evaluation)")
                _log({"call": label, "phase": "injected", "fault": FAULT, "exc": type(exc).__name__})
                raise exc
        try:
            r = orig(*a, **k)
        except BaseException as e:      # noqa: B902 -- logged and re-raised unchanged
            _log({"call": label, "phase": "raise", "exc": type(e).__name__, "msg": str(e)[:400]})
            raise
        _log(dict({"call": label, "phase": "return"}, **(result(r) if result else {})))
        return r

    setattr(owner, name, wrapper)


def _install():

    import metrix_e1.frozen as FZ
    import metrix_e1.gate as G
    import metrix_e1.pilot as P
    import metrix_e1.record as R
    import metrix_e1.test_data as TD
    import metrix_e1.testgate as TG
    import metrix_e1.train as T
    _wrap(P, "run_test_evaluate", result=lambda r: {"result": _short(r)})
    _wrap(P, "test_evaluate", result=lambda r: {"result": _short(r[0])})
    _wrap(P, "final_record", describe=lambda a, k: {"command": a[1], "status": a[2], "stop": a[6] if len(a) > 6 else k.get("stop")})
    _wrap(P, "write_experiment_record", result=lambda r: {"paths": [os.path.basename(str(x)) for x in r]})
    _wrap(P, "control_evaluation", describe=lambda a, k: {"what": a[2], "split": k.get("split", "dev")})
    _wrap(P, "test_evaluation_seconds", describe=lambda a, k: {"timing": a[1]}, result=lambda r: {"seconds": r})
    _wrap(P.Pilot, "start_checks", describe=lambda a, k: {"command": a[1]}, label="Pilot.start_checks")
    _wrap(R, "committed_json", describe=lambda a, k: {"rel": str(a[1])}, label="R.committed_json")
    _wrap(R, "committed_record", describe=lambda a, k: {"rel": str(a[1])}, label="R.committed_record")
    _wrap(T, "state_sha256", result=lambda r: {"sha256": r}, label="T.state_sha256")
    _wrap(TD, "check_preconditions")
    _wrap(FZ, "file_sha256", describe=lambda a, k: {"file": os.path.basename(str(a[0]))}, result=lambda r: {"sha256": r},
          only=lambda a, k: str(a[0]).endswith(".pt"))
    _wrap(TG, "begin_test_evaluation", describe=lambda a, k: {"base_sha256": a[3] if len(a) > 3 else k.get("base_model_sha256")},
          result=lambda r: {"marker_commit": getattr(r, "marker_commit", None)})
    _wrap(TG, "claim_checkpoint", describe=lambda a, k: {"checkpoint": a[1]})
    _wrap(TG, "commit_paths", describe=lambda a, k: {"rels": list(a[1])}, result=lambda r: {"head": r})
    _wrap(TG, "finish_test_evaluation", result=lambda r: {"head": r})
    _wrap(E, "evaluate_model", describe=lambda a, k: {"split": k.get("split", "dev"),
                                                      "checkpoint": k.get("checkpoint_name")})
    _wrap(G, "compute_test_values")
    _wrap(G, "judge_test", result=lambda r: {"final_status": r.get("final_status")})
    _wrap(G, "report_comparisons", describe=lambda a, k: {"split": a[2] if len(a) > 2 else k.get("split")})
    _STATE["installed"] = True
    _log({"call": "plugin", "phase": "installed", "fault": FAULT})

def pytest_runtest_call(item):

              "RuntimeError; 2 claims, 2 state hashes after begin; no finish; final_record('test-evaluate', 'BLOCKED', "
              "stop code None / status BLOCKED / message 'crash after the TEST marker: RuntimeError(...)'); "
              "commit_paths [experiment record json, txt]; run_test_evaluate raises RuntimeError (pytest exit 1)",
              "remote after the fixture: exactly 2 commits: marker only, then experiment record json + txt; no result; "
              "the record's Status BLOCKED, Actual {'crashed': ...}; the clone is clean and at the remote's tip; "
              "test_details/ 2 files"]
    p += ["no added blob holds the synthetic TEST text %s; the result and the experiment records have no key starting "
          "with 'general_test' and no per-question / per-window row key %s; no TEST data file in the clone or the "
          "remote; this repository unchanged" % (list(TEXT_NEEDLES), sorted(ROW_KEYS))]
    return p


def runs_of(trace):
    out, cur = [], None
    for ev in trace:
        if ev["call"] == "run_test_evaluate" and ev["phase"] == "enter":
            cur = []
        elif ev["call"] == "run_test_evaluate" and cur is not None:
            out.append((cur, ev))
            cur = None
        elif cur is not None:
            cur.append(ev)
    if cur is not None:
        out.append((cur, None))
    return out


def calls(evs, name, phase="enter"):
    return [e for e in evs if e["call"] == name and e["phase"] == phase]


def idx(evs, pred):
    for i, e in enumerate(evs):
        if pred(e):
            return i
    return None


def before_begin(evs, n3_sha):
    """The pre-marker part of a run (events before begin's enter). Returns (dict of observations, index of begin)."""
    ib = idx(evs, lambda e: e["call"] == "begin_test_evaluation" and e["phase"] == "enter")
    pre = evs[:ib] if ib is not None else evs
    reads = [e["rel"] for e in calls(pre, "R.committed_record") + calls(pre, "R.committed_json")]
    reads_sorted = [e["rel"] for e in sorted(calls(pre, "R.committed_record") + calls(pre, "R.committed_json"),
                                             key=lambda e: e["seq"])]
    first_pt = idx(pre, lambda e: e["call"] == "file_sha256" and e["phase"] == "enter")
    four = [r for r in reads_sorted if r in (FREEZE, GATE0, STEP2, STEP3)]
    i4 = [idx(pre, lambda e, r=r: e["call"] in ("R.committed_record", "R.committed_json") and e["phase"] == "enter"
              and e["rel"] == r) for r in (FREEZE, GATE0, STEP2, STEP3)]
    tes = calls(pre, "test_evaluation_seconds", "return")
    tes_in = calls(pre, "test_evaluation_seconds")
    br = calls(pre, "p.before_run")
    sh = calls(pre, "T.state_sha256", "return")
    obs = {"check_preconditions": len(calls(pre, "check_preconditions")),
           "start_checks": [e["command"] for e in calls(pre, "Pilot.start_checks")],
           "four_records_read_in_order_before_the_checkpoint_loop": four[:4] == [FREEZE, GATE0, STEP2, STEP3]
           and None not in i4 and first_pt is not None and max(i4) < first_pt,
           "pt_hashes": sorted(e["file"] for e in calls(pre, "file_sha256")),
           "test_evaluation_seconds": [round(e["seconds"], 9) for e in tes],
           "timing_argument_is_the_fixture's": [e["timing"] == FIXTURE_TIMING for e in tes_in],
           "before_run": [round(e["next_seconds"], 9) for e in br],
           "state_hashes": [e["sha256"] for e in sh],
           "base_hash_equals_step3_N": [e["sha256"] == n3_sha for e in sh]}
    return obs, ib, len(reads)

    ap.add_argument("--out", required=True)

    try:

    except (PreconditionFailed, ProtocolStop) as e:
        print("TEST generator refused: %s" % e)
        print("no TEST content was generated, read or written")

        sys.exit(1)
    out = Path(a.out)
    root = fz.repo_root.resolve()
    if out.resolve() == root or root in out.resolve().parents:
        raise ImplementationFail("--out %s is inside the repository %s; TEST content is never committed" % (out, root))
    present = [n for n in D.TEST_FILES if (out / n).exists()]
    if present:

    TG.refuse_if_st10_record(root)

                                                              "OVER LIMIT" if c in over else "within limit"))

PY = sys.argv[1]
PI = Path("metrix/e1-pilot/src/metrix_e1/pilot.py")
RP = Path("metrix/e1-pilot/run_pilot.py")
T = "tests/test_run_pilot.py::"
E2E = T + "test_test_evaluate_end_to_end_once"
CKPT = T + "test_every_checkpoint_reloads_with_the_same_state_hash"
CKPT_BAD = T + "test_a_checkpoint_that_does_not_reload_identically_is_refused"
STOPS = T + "test_smoke_records_the_value_stops_and_formal_raises_them"
CHAIN = T + "test_formal_commit_chain_through_the_freeze_record"
RECORDS = T + "test_test_evaluate_records_after_the_marker_and_for_st10"
CONT = T + "test_continuity_checks_before_anything"

MUTS = [
    ("checkpoint: reload hash not compared", PI, "        if again != sha:\n", "        if False:\n", CKPT_BAD),
    ("checkpoint: label not checked", PI, 'if ck.get("run") != spec.name or ck.get("label") != self.mode.label:',
     'if ck.get("run") != spec.name:', CKPT_BAD),

    ("work directory inside the repository", PI, "        if not outside(self.work, self.root):\n",
     "        if False:\n", T + "test_work_directory_inside_the_repository_is_refused"),

     'SMOKE_RECORDED_STOPS = ("ST1", "ST2", "ST3", "ST4", "ST5", "ST11")', STOPS),
    ("formal: no device check before step 1", PI, "        p.device_info_record = p.device_check()\n        if p.mode.formal:",

    ("step 1: manifest change outside the step-1 field", PI,
     "        if FZ.strip_step1_fields(rel, json.loads(blob)) != FZ.strip_step1_fields(rel, json.loads(fz.blobs[rel])):",
     "        if False:", T + "test_step1_writes_only_the_fields_st12_leaves_out"),
    ("step 1: split_sha256 not written", PI,
     '            sm["split_sha256"][name] = file_hashes[name]["canonical_sha256"]',
     '            sm["split_sha256"][name] = sm["split_sha256"][name]',
     T + "test_step1_writes_only_the_fields_st12_leaves_out"),
    ("model directory: revision not compared", PI, "        if got != rev:\n", "        if False:\n",
     T + "test_model_directory_against_the_frozen_revision"),
    ("smoke records without their label", PI, "rec = dict(plain(obj), mode=self.mode.name, label=self.mode.label)",
     "rec = dict(plain(obj), mode=self.mode.name, label=None)",
     T + "test_smoke_outputs_are_labelled_and_stay_in_the_work_directory"),
    ("run records under 'runs' (git-ignored)", PI, 'RUNS_DIR, DETAILS_DIR = "training_runs", "details"',
     'RUNS_DIR, DETAILS_DIR = "runs", "details"', T + "test_no_formal_record_path_is_ignored_by_git " + E2E),
    ("formal takes a step count", RP,
     '        x = a if name == "smoke" else sub.add_parser(name)\n',
     '        x = a if name == "smoke" else sub.add_parser(name)\n        if name != "smoke":\n'

     T + "test_formal_commands_have_no_step_option"),
    ("TEST: checkpoint files not checked before the marker", PI,

     'if command == "formal" and TG._blob(self.root, "HEAD:%s" % R.SELECTION_FREEZE_REL) is not None:',

]


def tree_sha():
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    files = (sorted(Path("metrix/e1-pilot/src").rglob("*.py")) + sorted(Path("metrix/e1-pilot/tests").rglob("*.py"))
             + [RP])
    for p in files:
        h.update(str(p).encode() + b"\0" + p.read_bytes())
    return h.hexdigest()


def parse(m):
    name, path, *rest = m
    pairs, tests = (rest[0], rest[1]) if isinstance(rest[0], list) else ([(rest[0], rest[1])], rest[2])
    return name, path, pairs, ["metrix/e1-pilot/" + t for t in tests.split()]


if __name__ == "__main__":
    before = tree_sha()
    caught = 0
    for m in MUTS:
        name, path, pairs, nodes = parse(m)
        orig = path.read_bytes()
        s = orig.decode("utf-8")
        bad = [s.count(old) for old, _ in pairs if s.count(old) != 1]
        if bad:
            print("%-48s -> MUTATION NOT APPLICABLE (%s matches)" % (name, bad))
            continue
        for old, new in pairs:
            s = s.replace(old, new)
        path.write_text(s, encoding="utf-8")
        try:
            r = subprocess.run([PY, "-m", "pytest", "-q", "-p", "no:cacheprovider", "-rf"] + nodes, capture_output=True,
                               text=True)
            last = r.stdout.strip().split("\n")[-1]
            failed = {ln.split(" ")[1] for ln in r.stdout.split("\n") if ln.startswith("FAILED ")}
            ok = r.returncode == 1 and all(n in failed for n in nodes)
            caught += ok
            print("%-48s -> %s exit %d | %s" % (name, "CAUGHT" if ok else "NOT CAUGHT", r.returncode, last))
            for n in nodes:
                print("       %s %s" % ("FAILED" if n in failed else "passed", n.split("::", 1)[1]))
        finally:
            path.write_bytes(orig)
    after = tree_sha()
    print("mutations %d, caught %d" % (len(MUTS), caught))
    print("src+tests+run_pilot sha256 before %s after %s %s" % (before, after, "EQUAL" if before == after else "DIFFERENT"))
    print("RESULT: %s" % ("PASS" if caught == len(MUTS) and before == after else "FAIL"))

"""ic8_07 (implementation stage C, C2 fix commit (staged tree b40224e6, parent 1900b1fe), round 1; supplementary): the
Executor's c2b_01 recording was killed while a mutation of c2_mutate_fix1.py was applied to the working tree

reports/impl_c/c2_mutate_fix1.py is READ as data with ast (never imported or executed): for each of its 25 mutations the
original text ("old") occurs exactly once in the STAGED blob of its file and in the working-tree file (a mutation left
applied would have removed it), and the two files are byte-identical. Data Auditor's own script.
usage: python -I -B ic8_07_mutation_remnants.py <repo_root>"""
import os
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import ast
import subprocess
from ia_common import run

MUT = "metrix/e1-pilot/reports/impl_c/c2_mutate_fix1.py"
FILES = {"PI": "metrix/e1-pilot/src/metrix_e1/pilot.py", "RP": "metrix/e1-pilot/run_pilot.py"}


def staged(repo, rel):
    r = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", repo, "cat-file", "blob", ":" + rel], capture_output=True, env=dict(os.environ, GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS="0"))
    assert r.returncode == 0, rel
    return r.stdout.decode("utf-8")


def main():
    repo = sys.argv[1]
    tree = ast.parse(staged(repo, MUT))
    muts = [n.value for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.Assign) and [ast.unparse(t) for t in n.targets] == ["MUTS"]][0]
    ok = True
    blobs = {k: staged(repo, v) for k, v in FILES.items()}
    wt = {k: open(os.path.join(repo, v), encoding="utf-8").read() for k, v in FILES.items()}
    for k in FILES:
        print("%s: staged blob == working tree file: %s" % (FILES[k], blobs[k] == wt[k]))
        ok &= blobs[k] == wt[k]
    n = 0
    for t in muts.elts:
        name = t.elts[0].value
        path = ast.unparse(t.elts[1])
        old = t.elts[2]
        assert isinstance(old, ast.Constant) and isinstance(old.value, str), name
        c = blobs[path].count(old.value)
        n += 1
        print("  %-62s %s: original text occurs %d time(s)" % (name, FILES[path].split("/")[-1], c))
        ok &= c == 1
    print("mutations read: %d (expected 25)" % n)
    ok &= n == 25
    return bool(ok)


run(main)

import os

import ast
import subprocess
from ia_common import run

MUT = "metrix/e1-pilot/reports/impl_c/c2_mutate_fix1.py"
FILES = {"PI": "metrix/e1-pilot/src/metrix_e1/pilot.py", "RP": "metrix/e1-pilot/run_pilot.py"}


def staged(repo, rel):
    r = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", repo, "cat-file", "blob", ":" + rel], capture_output=True, env=dict(os.environ, GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS="0"))
    assert r.returncode == 0, rel
    return r.stdout.decode("utf-8")


def main():
    repo = sys.argv[1]
    tree = ast.parse(staged(repo, MUT))
    muts = [n.value for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.Assign) and [ast.unparse(t) for t in n.targets] == ["MUTS"]][0]
    ok = True
    blobs = {k: staged(repo, v) for k, v in FILES.items()}
    wt = {k: open(os.path.join(repo, v), encoding="utf-8").read() for k, v in FILES.items()}
    for k in FILES:
        print("%s: staged blob == working tree file: %s" % (FILES[k], blobs[k] == wt[k]))
        ok &= blobs[k] == wt[k]
    n = 0
    for t in muts.elts:
        name = t.elts[0].value
        path = ast.unparse(t.elts[1])
        old = t.elts[2]
        assert isinstance(old, ast.Constant) and isinstance(old.value, str), name
        c = blobs[path].count(old.value)

        print("  %-62s %s: original text occurs %d time(s)" % (name, FILES[path].split("/")[-1], c))
